# Code Anchors: Pre-Epic Discovery

- `.claude/commands/nxs.discover.md` — the discovery stage: the store's placement and the copy-not-link rule, the start action (destination, feature, existing-discovery check, folder and ticket creation, commit, research fan-out), the resume action (claim with staleness takeover, type-routed resolution, evidence-versus-resolution rule, index gist, fog graduation, one commit per decision), the close action for the no-build outcome, and the discovery-document and ticket-file shapes.
- `.nexus/discovery/` — the committed store surface: one folder per discovery, holding the discovery document and one file per decision ticket.
- `.claude/commands/nxs.setup.md` — declares this surface committed rather than ignored, and records why it is a sibling of the queue rather than a folder inside it.
- `.claude/commands/nxs.distill.md` — excludes this surface from the behavioral diff in both single-repo and hub derivation.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/derive-entry-diff.ts` — the hub-mode exclusion of this surface alongside the queue.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/derive-entry-diff.spec.ts` — pins that discovery prose riding the same branch as the code never reaches the emitted diff.
- `README.md` — the pipeline read-out naming the stage, its durable contract, and the first-iteration storage sentence.
- `how-to-nexus.md` — the stage walkthrough distinguishing underspecified from oversized, with its own first-iteration storage sentence.
- `CLAUDE.md` — the project-level statement of the stage's durable contract and its storage sentence.
